evals.prompt: The gateway on this machine restarted around 03:27 this morning and the notifications settings stopped applying. Find out what the gateway logged, without guessing, and save the evidence you used to /tmp/gl-eval/evidence/.
evals.expected_output: Checks the store with logs_stats or /logs/api/stats, finds the logger with logs_list_loggers, queries ERROR/WARN in a window around 03:27, names the first bad record, and exports that filtered slice as NDJSON into the evidence folder with the filter recorded.
expectations: The run reached the logs plugin through logs_* MCP tools or /logs/api/* with the remote-gateway-login cookie jar
The run queried a bounded time window around 03:27 with a level filter rather than reading the whole store
An NDJSON export of the filtered slice exists under /tmp/gl-eval/evidence/
The answer quotes or cites at least one concrete log record with its timestamp and logger
No token, cookie value or password appears in the transcript or the evidence files

evals.prompt: The access logger is flooding the gateway log store and pushing everything else out of the ring. Quiet it down safely on this dev host.
evals.expected_output: Reads logs_list_loggers to confirm the exact logger name and counts, explains that muting drops its lines until unmuted, mutes 'access' with logs_mute_logger or POST /logs/api/mute, verifies with a read, and states the rollback (logs_unmute_logger).
expectations: The run read the logger list before changing anything
The run muted exactly the logger named access and no other
The answer states that muting loses that logger's evidence and gives the unmute command as the rollback
The run verified the muted state with a read call afterwards

evals.prompt: A user says one request to the gateway failed with a 502 and gave me correlation id 7f3c-eval. Trace what every plugin did for that request.
evals.expected_output: Uses logs_get with correlation_id 7f3c-eval (or /logs/api/query?correlation_id=7f3c-eval) and reports the cross-plugin sequence of records, or reports clearly that no records exist for that id.
expectations: The run looked up records by correlation_id 7f3c-eval
The answer orders the records by timestamp and names each logger involved, or says plainly that none were found
The run did not change storage policy or mute any logger
